summary.walkthrough: This PR introduces deduplication of comments in the emit function to prevent multiple comments at the same location from being posted. It also includes tests for this new functionality and updates the DeepSeek model configuration to use the latest models.

change_groups.title: Comment Deduplication and Testing
change_groups.summary: The emit function now includes a deduplication step that removes duplicate comments at the same location, keeping only the first occurrence. A new helper function, dedupeCommentsByLocation, has been added to handle this logic, and corresponding tests have been implemented to ensure its correctness.

change_groups.title: Scanner Findings Filtering
change_groups.summary: New functionality has been added to filter scanner findings to only include those relevant to the changed paths, excluding findings from non-reviewable paths such as vendor directories and agent worktrees. Tests have been added to verify this filtering behavior.

change_groups.title: DeepSeek Model Updates
change_groups.summary: The DeepSeek model configuration has been updated to use 'deepseek-chat' as the default model and 'deepseek-reasoner' as an additional option. Tests have been adjusted to reflect these changes, ensuring that the correct models are being referenced.

change_groups.title: Ambient Authentication Handling
change_groups.summary: Enhancements have been made to handle ambient authentication for providers that do not require an API key. A new function, resolveAmbientPreset, has been introduced to facilitate this, ensuring that the correct model is used when ambient authentication is in play.

summary.testing_notes: Reviewers should run the emit function with various configurations to ensure that duplicate comments are correctly deduplicated. Additionally, run the scanner functionality to verify that only relevant findings are returned, and check the DeepSeek model configurations in the tests to confirm they are correctly set.
summary.risk: medium: The changes involve significant logic alterations in comment handling and model configurations, which could affect the output if not thoroughly tested.
